items.title: Scattered Lapsus$ Hunters Returns With Salesforce Leak Site
items.description: After claiming it would shut down, the cybercriminal collective reemerged and threatened to publish the stolen data of Salesforce customers by Oct. 10 if its demands are not met.

items.title: Dutch Authorities Arrest Two Teens for Alleged Pro-Russian Espionage
items.description: Dutch Prime Minister Dick Schoof described the incident as part of a broader pattern of Russian hybrid attacks against Europe.

items.title: Detour Dog Caught Running DNS-Powered Malware Factory for Strela Stealer
items.description: A threat actor named Detour Dog has been outed as powering campaigns distributing an information stealer known as Strela Stealer. That's according to findings from Infoblox, which found the threat actor to maintain control of domains hosting the first stage of the stealer, a backdoor called StarFish.
